basics.name: Oliver Lindgren
basics.label: Senior Software Developer and UI/UX Designer
basics.summary:
A highly skilled software developer with 15 years of experience in software development and 6 years in design, Oliver has a proven track record of creating and delivering a diverse range of B2B and B2C solutions. He has a strong passion for building modern web applications that are performant, functionally robust, visually appealing, and compatible across all major platforms. Driven by a desire to simplify users' lives, Oliver is always eager to explore innovative approaches to user interface design and development.

As a certified Scrum Master, Oliver is an effective team player and is well-equipped to lead development teams and manage specification tasks. His business-first mindset allows him to approach challenges strategically, consistently advocating for solutions that align with business goals. Oliver has the ability to constructively challenge both teams and clients at critical moments.
basics.x-tagline: As a developer, my aim is always to create user experiences so smooth they go unnoticed: interfaces that anticipate what people need, adapt to them and make even complicated tasks feel easy.

x-keySkills.title: Frontend development
x-keySkills.description: Oliver understands what it takes to make services genuinely usable, going beyond merely meeting minimum criteria. Oliver has an excellent eye for creating visually polished interfaces and crafting interaction animations that feel natural.

x-keySkills.title: Design through tech and vice versa
x-keySkills.description: Oliver ensures the design aligns with the data, minimizing unnecessary complexity while maintaining clean, efficient codebases. Likewise, Oliver can identify when a strong UX indicator calls for underlying backend schema changes, in order to avoid having logic spread out in multiple layers of the software architecture when not needed.

x-keySkills.title: AI Experience: Project Experience
x-keySkills.description: Oliver has developed various components and chat interfaces where an AI model generates a response to user inputs.

x-keySkills.title: AI Experience: AI development tools
x-keySkills.description: In recent customer projects, Oliver has been utilizing AI development tools to speed up the development process.

work.name: Kipinä Software Oy
work.position: Senior Software Developer and UI/UX Designer

projects.name: Self-service kiosk API migration
projects.description: As part of the client's hotel team, Oliver was responsible for migrating every Keskus Hotels self-service kiosk to use a new API. As there was no-one left with knowledge of the codebase, Oliver made a clear action plan for the project, with visual mappings of the old schema to the new. The codebase got modernized to TypeScript while unnecessary complexity and business-logic got removed from the front-end, making it easier to maintain and less error-prone.
projects.x-note: Project list title names the cooperative retail group and its hotel chain; the highlight gives '2025 - Ongoing', the project list '11/2025 – Ongoing'.

projects.name: Event venue and meeting room booking service
projects.description: Oliver was part of the development team of the client's event management system, where he helped bring new features that better serve todays expectations when it comes to booking event locations and meeting rooms. The tasks included refactoring complex logic, combining data from multiple external API's, modifying backend endpoint, A/B testing and Black Friday campaign flags through LaunchDarkly and photography/videography of content to use in the frontpage video banner. A big focus was also put on accessibility, where the service was continuously improved in order to pass higher levels of accessibility audits.

projects.name: Sustainability analysis and reporting SaaS
projects.description: Oliver led the development of the user interface for a web-based SaaS focused on sustainability analysis and reporting. Utilized Next.js to build a user-friendly frontend, while also contributing to visual design and the creation of custom data visualizations to enhance the clarity and impact of sustainability metrics. Collaborated closely with backend engineers to design a new API, helping define and shape the endpoints needed to support the platform's data.

projects.name: Journalist productivity tools and election services
projects.description: As part of the broadcaster's news innovation lab team, Oliver designed and developed tools used by journalists to boost productivity as well as election-related services. Many of the tools Oliver helped develop utilized AI and custom LLM's to help users understand complex topics and to summarize large data sets.

projects.name: Photo postcard service renewal
projects.description: Oliver renewed and modernized the client's photo postcard service, turning it from a desktop service into an accessible and responsive service, compatible with all devices and in line with the client's updated brand guidelines.

projects.name: Disruption messaging flow editor
projects.description: Oliver created an interactive drag-and-drop interface for the maintenance and creation of different flows for customer-oriented disruption messaging related to train delays and interruptions. The tool allowed users to visually create event nodes on a canvas, where each node could be connected to another, resulting in a flow diagram that determines which combination of events results in what type of customer message.
